title: Power Rankings: Pistons hold off KG-less Celtics
heading: 2007-08 Power Rankings: Week 15
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: With Commissioner Stern, of all people, naming Sheed as KG's All-Star replacement, we gave deep thought to dropping the Pistons in the midst of an eight-game win streak just to make sure they still feel disrespected.
rankings.summaryText: With Commissioner Stern, of all people, naming Sheed as KG's All-Star replacement, we gave deep thought to dropping the Pistons in the midst of an eight-game win streak just to make sure they still feel disrespected.

rankings.summaryHtml: The Celts can't feel too solid until they know exactly when KG will be back, but fair is fair: Boston probably deserves co-No. 1 status after following up their Dallas win without KG by beating the Spurs without him, too.

rankings.summaryHtml: At 5-1 since the big trade and with Kobe clearly energized by the blockbuster move he's been waiting for, there's only one complaint in Lakerland: Pau won't make his home debut until after the All-Star break.

rankings.summaryHtml: Marbury might be done for the season, but the Knicks can no longer claim that that's any sort of plus. They endured an eight-game losing streak in November with Steph and just suffered through another one without him.
